messages:
ela: quick design sync on API Keys list — two pain points: long scope lists blow out rows, and the reveal/copy affordance is inconsistent on mobile. attaching tiny mock: https://figma.com/file/keys-compact
mike: for long lists I propose a single-line summary '4 scopes • show' that expands a focusable dialog. keeps rows consistent.
sam: fine, but dialog must be keyboard accessible. make the chips decorative (aria-hidden) and expose an offscreen summary for screen readers.
nora: accessibility nit: 'show' button should use aria-expanded and the dialog needs focus trap + esc handling. announce when dialog opens via aria-live.
mike: reveal flow: prefer 'Copy' as primary (ghost) button left, 'Reveal' second. reveal shows key for 30s with a progress indicator and an aria-live polite announcement.
sam: implement detail: clipboard copy should update an aria-live region 'API key copied' and show transient 'Copied!' state on the button.
ux-bot: accessibility checklist: require confirm if session auth older than 15m, aria-label for reveal: 'Reveal API key. Visible for 30 seconds.', and polite live region on reveal/copy.
ela: ephemeral keys: instead of toast-only, show an inline expiry pill in the post-create preview card (e.g., 'expires in 45m') so users can revoke earlier.
mike: revoke modal: add optional reason dropdown and freeform note. show tiny privacy copy: 'Notes visible to org admins for auditing.'
sam: back-end note: add revoke_reason + revoke_note to audit events. front-end to POST /api/keys/:id/revoke with those fields.
nora: screen-reader copy for revoke confirmation: 'API key "{name}" will be revoked. This cannot be undone.' include reason in live announcement after success.
mike: mobile: collapse actions behind kebab but keep 'Copy' visible. ensure touch targets >=44px; no swipe-to-delete gestures.
ela: next steps: 1) mike to update figma with summary+dialog and expiry pill, 2) sam to write aria snippets and clipboard live-region text, 3) nora to draft confirm wording, 4) infra to add audit fields behind flag. I'll file acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:
